description: This registered collection describes linked healthcare service episodes from the Local Health Authority of Alba and Bra in Piedmont, Italy. The Bruno Kessler Foundation hosts its Zenodo metadata. Coverage runs from January 2019 to April 2024 and includes inpatient, outpatient, emergency, residential, home, hospice and medication services. The article reports records for about 175,000 patients, including over 2.8 million ambulatory visits and 252,000 emergency episodes. Zenodo marks access restricted and requires a request, intended-use description, agreement and ethical review. Metadata state CC BY 4.0; no price is stated, and file formats and public file contents are unverified. These access conditions and the local administrative population are material limitations. Modellers could use approved access to estimate care pathways and service demand in healthcare simulations. model-patient-flow-network-analysis-uk-hospitals and model-khp-patient-flow-simulator are related resources. Only public metadata and the article were reviewed; no patient records were requested or downloaded.
